periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, angled approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the head.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; vertical height significantly exceeds horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering with the lower boundary extending toward the muzzle area.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile along the posterior edge of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, covering roughly one-third of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, exceeding the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, convex semicircular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow discoloration visible on the ventral/abdominal fur compared to the cranial white fur.
